objective_value: <float> Total construction, transportation, and quadratic congestion cost represented by the complete witness.
model_variables: <dict, key: canonical variable name> Sparse complete witness; omitted variables are zero. Keys use Gurobi bracket syntax exactly as specified by model_variable_name_patterns.
z: <dict, key: '{edge}'> Whether each edge is activated for use in the network (1 = constructed, 0 = not constructed).

model_variable_name_patterns.z[e]: binary design variable for edge e
model_variable_name_patterns.x[k,r,e]: commodity k, scenario r, edge e flow
model_variable_name_patterns.tf[r,e]: total scenario flow on edge e
